example: Vamos a cambiar el pañal.
exampleTranslation: Let's change your nappy.

example: Uy, se terminaron las toallitas.
exampleTranslation: Oops, we've run out of wipes.

example: Arriba al cambiador, mi amor.
exampleTranslation: Up onto the changing mat, my love.

example: Te pongo un poco de crema.
exampleTranslation: I'll put a little cream on you.

example: ¿Quieres sentarte en la pelela?
exampleTranslation: Do you want to sit on the potty?

example: ¿Tienes hambre? Ya está tu mamadera.
exampleTranslation: Are you hungry? Your bottle is ready.

example: Primero el babero, después la comida.
exampleTranslation: Bib first, then food.

example: Te siento en la sillita alta.
exampleTranslation: I'll sit you in the high chair.

example: ¿Quieres probar con la cuchara?
exampleTranslation: Do you want to try with the spoon?

example: ¡Te comiste todo el plato!
exampleTranslation: You ate the whole plate!

example: Agarra el vaso con las dos manos.
exampleTranslation: Hold the cup with both hands.

example: Te dejo en la cuna un ratito.
exampleTranslation: I'll leave you in the cot for a little while.

example: ¿Dónde quedó tu chupete?
exampleTranslation: Where has your dummy got to?

example: Te tapo con la mantita.
exampleTranslation: I'll cover you with your blanket.

example: Es hora de la siesta, mi amor.
exampleTranslation: It's nap time, sweetheart.

example: Dejo el monitor prendido, duerme tranquilo.
exampleTranslation: I'll leave the baby monitor on, sleep well.

example: Sube al cochecito, que nos vamos.
exampleTranslation: Into the pushchair, we're off.

example: ¿Pusiste pañales en el bolso?
exampleTranslation: Did you put nappies in the bag?

example: Hoy te llevo en el portabebé.
exampleTranslation: Today I'll carry you in the baby carrier.

example: Te pongo protector solar en la cara.
exampleTranslation: I'll put sunscreen on your face.
